[[File:T.J. Holman DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|260px|T.J. Holman at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''T.J. Holman''' was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. Holman qualified through Open DragonCon Atlanta from Coatesville, Pennsylvania.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Holman published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs and finished 2nd at the [[1999 Origins Open]].
